title: Close the idea-105 audit holes with fixed copies of the tests: attack 90 cipher feed 30-33 (bug), 59 cipher feed 34-60 / plain feed 7-8, 88 progressive key across word breaks (stacked keys re-checked against idea 104), 60C Slidefair same-column rule, 61 clockwise quarter turns, 69B join on key letters, 57 key letter M[s+c] / KRYPTOS[s+c]
k4_result: 0 passes in every hole. 90: 0 of 440,215,072 settings pass with 7+ checks (chance 0.0002). 59: 0 of 56,400 pass with 6+ (chance 0.00004). 88 progressive: 0 of 216,241,920,700 exact tests (chance 7e-7). 60C: 0 of 112 settings have all 11 clue pairs agree (chance 7e-14). 61: 0 of 5,048,760 pass with 6+ (chance 0.0008). 69B: 0 joined signatures out of 2.6e15 row-2 x row-4 signature pairs with 9-10 checks (chance 0.71). 57: best key fragment over the 132,190,800 new readings scores -4.841 (HELMINTHAGOGUE Q3/diana KR+16: RAPINISLEANYJ|KLSNSORINGD, not English), within 0.07 of the controls and below the attack's 0.35 margin. controls: 3 shuffled K4s, each on a different third of the alphabets: 90 0/0/0 passes (146.7M settings each); 88 progressive 0/0/0 (72.1G each); 69B 0/0/0 joins (chance 0.09 each); 57 best -4.908, -4.970, -4.989. 10 shuffled K4s on the parts with no alphabet list: 59 0 passes each, 60C 0 each, 61 0 each. planted: Every judgeable idea-105 plant of the holes found: 282 of 312 hole-cell messages found, 30 with too few checks (all in 59, where the audit's key lengths 7-26 leave fewer than 6 checks), 0 missed. 576 messages from the cells the old attacks already found: 544 found, 32 too few checks, 0 missed. Read back end to end: 8/8 (90 lags 30/32/33 with words 2/3/4: 76 letters each, 0 wrong, English -4.25 to -4.53; 59 cipher lags 40 and 55 read back exactly; 57 key set under A on M/M, M/KR, KR/M: the true key fragment is the top score among 3,000 alphabets). Control: 52 hole-cell messages with the clue one letter late: 0 found.
scope_limits: Only the holes idea 105 found are closed, and only in the scope of each attack: 90 cipher feed 30-33 with a word of 2-4 (666,993 alphabets, 5 layouts, Vig/Beau, feed numbered on M/A-Z/KRYPTOS, both signs); 59 A-Z/KRYPTOS only, cipher feed 34-60 and plain feed 7-8 (plain feed 9 still can't be judged); 88 progressive key on 220,318 keyword alphabets at the 15 (parsing, length) cells with no in-run pair (lengths 6-12 / 9-12 / 11-12), starts 0..p-1, offsets 0-25; 88 stacked keys were not rerun on K4 (idea 104 part 'breaks' already ran them); 60C A-Z/KRYPTOS only, same-column rule taking the letters to the right (ACA); 61 clockwise single turns and double turns mixing directions at widths 2-48, 97 and 98 cells, A-Z/KRYPTOS views; 69B 220,318 keyword alphabets, rows 2 and 4 only (the clue rows), the key letter read on each row's own cipher strip; 57 the 50 new readings on Q3, Q4a, Q4b only, scored on 24 key letters. 'Tested' leaves out the 69B signature pairs (2.6e15). Not touched: attacks 55, 58, 67, 75-77, 82, 83, 85 (never audited); attack 81's progressive length 11-12 with a wrong letter inside clue 1; 62 widths 10+, 65 taps 9-10, 69A shifts -5/-4 (not judgeable).

negative.hypothesis: K4 is one of the simple remembered-key ciphers sitting in a region that idea 105 showed the old attacks never really tested: row-keys-row autokey with cipher feed 30-33 back plus a word of 2-4, autokey + repeating key with cipher feed 34-60 or plain feed 7-8, a progressive key running over word spaces, Slidefair with same-column pairs, a key scrambled by a clockwise K3 turn, rows of 21 with a different tableau per row keyed by letters, or an English running key set under a letter other than the strip's first.
negative.scope: Fixed copies of the test functions (kryptos/idea118_holes.py), run only on the missed settings: 90 440.2M settings; 59 56,400; 88 progressive 216.2G exact tests (220,318 alphabets x 10 streams x 3,926 position sets x 25 steps, each exact); 60C 112; 61 5.0M; 69B join over 2.2M x 2.2M streams x 26 letters; 57 132.2M readings scored as English. 7+ checks (59 and 61 also at their own 6).
negative.outcome: Dead: K4 0 passes in every hole (chance predicts 0.0002 / 0.00004 / 7e-7 / 7e-14 / 0.0008 / 0.71 for 90 / 59 / 88 / 60C / 61 / 69B); 57 best -4.841 vs shuffled -4.908 to -4.989, not English (controls: 3 shuffled K4s on thirds 0 passes, 10 shuffles for 59/60C/61 0 passes; planted: 282/312 hole plants found, 30 unjudgeable, 0 missed; 8/8 read back; clue one letter late 0/52).

follow_ups: Audit the attacks idea 105 left out (55, 58, 67, 75-77, 82, 83, 85) with the same textbook-encryptor method, so their negatives can be trusted to the same standard.
